import json
import sys


def solve(req):
    ebits = req["ebits"]
    fbits = req["fbits"]
    mode = req["mode"]
    pairs = req["pairs"]

    F = 1 << fbits
    Eall = (1 << ebits) - 1
    bias = (1 << (ebits - 1)) - 1
    emin = 1 - bias
    emax = Eall - 1 - bias
    signpos = ebits + fbits
    fracmask = F - 1
    qbit = 1 << (fbits - 1)

    def parse(h):
        v = int(h, 16) if h else 0
        return (v >> signpos) & 1, (v >> fbits) & Eall, v & fracmask

    invalid = False
    any_nan = False
    inf_signs = 0          # bit0: +inf product seen, bit1: -inf product seen
    prods = []             # (sign, mantissa, exponent) finite products
    all_neg_zero = True
    nprod = 0

    for pair in pairs:
        sa, ea, fa = parse(pair[0])
        sb, eb, fb = parse(pair[1])

        a_nan = ea == Eall and fa != 0
        b_nan = eb == Eall and fb != 0
        if a_nan or b_nan:
            any_nan = True
            if (a_nan and not (fa & qbit)) or (b_nan and not (fb & qbit)):
                invalid = True
            continue

        a_inf = ea == Eall
        b_inf = eb == Eall
        a_zero = ea == 0 and fa == 0
        b_zero = eb == 0 and fb == 0

        if (a_zero and b_inf) or (a_inf and b_zero):
            invalid = True
            continue

        if a_inf or b_inf:
            if sa ^ sb:
                inf_signs |= 2
            else:
                inf_signs |= 1
            continue

        nprod += 1
        if ea == 0:
            ma, xa = fa, 1 - bias - fbits
        else:
            ma, xa = F + fa, ea - bias
